review:
Sweet Bonanza 2500 is the latest entry in Pragmatic's best-known candy series. Eight to 12 or more matching treats anywhere on the 6×5 grid pay instantly, and winning symbols tumble away for new ones.

Four or more lollipop scatters trigger 10 free spins, where candy bomb multipliers now reach 2,500x, and three more scatters add five spins. Pragmatic lists wins of up to 25,000x and a 96.52% RTP. Compared with the original, the base game is the same; the difference is the much bigger bomb values in the bonus. It suits players who enjoy the original and want more upside from the feature.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
